title: Course records fall in Ljubljana (short item in the Amsterdam report)

story.W: Haftamnesh Tesfaye won by seven seconds in a course record.
story.M: Enock Onchari won in a course record with a 1:01:42 second half.

performances.name: Haftamnesh TESFAYE
performances.note: Course record and personal best 2:19:17, winning by seven seconds.
